## Lumentum Holdings 8-K Report, Material Agreement (Nov 2, 2026)

Lumentum Holdings Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Marvell Technology, Inc. in an all-stock transaction. The merger agreement, approved unanimously by Lumentum's board, will see Lumentum stockholders receive 4.500 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum common stock they own. This transaction creates a significant entity in the AI connectivity space, combining Marvell's electrical and optical interconnect, network switching, and custom silicon expertise with Lumentum's strengths in high-performance lasers, optical transceivers, and specialized semiconductor manufacturing. The strategic rationale centers on addressing the escalating bandwidth requirements and architectural shifts in AI infrastructure towards optical technologies. The combined company aims to offer a comprehensive, full-stack connectivity portfolio capable of enabling end-to-end co-design, accelerating customer innovation, and expanding the total addressable market to an estimated $550 billion. Marvell anticipates the transaction will enhance long-term revenue growth, improve non-GAAP gross and operating margins, and be accretive to its non-GAAP earnings per share within the first year post-closing, with projected annual run-rate cost synergies exceeding $1 billion.

ultimate.snippet:
On December 19, 2025 (the “Effective Date”), Lumentum Holdings Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”), entered into a credit agreement (the “Credit Agreement”), by and among the Company, as borrower, the lenders from time to time party thereto (the “Lenders”) and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as administrative agent (in such capacity, the “Administrative Agent”) and collateral agent.
The Credit Agreement provides for a senior secured revolving credit facility in an aggregate principal amount of $400.0 million, including a $23.0 million sublimit for the issuance of letters of credit. The Credit Agreement provides that the Company has the right at any time and from time to time to incur one or more incremental revolving commitments and/or incremental term loans up to an unlimited amount, subject to certain customary conditions precedent and other requirements. The Lenders are not obligated to provide any such incremental loans or commitments. The proceeds of the loans under the Credit Agreement may be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. As of the Effective Date, the Company had no outstanding revolving loans or letters of credit under the Credit Agreement.

# Lumentum secures $400M revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo Bank
● Dec 2025
Lumentum has entered into a Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank establishing a senior secured $400 million revolving credit facility for working capital and general corporate purposes. The five-year facility allows borrowings, repayments and reborrowings until maturity. Interest rates are based on either a base rate or term SOFR plus a margin tied to secured net leverage, with an unused commitment fee applied. The agreement includes customary covenants and financial tests. No borrowings or letters of credit were outstanding at signing. Wells Fargo Bank serves as administrative agent alongside other lenders in the facility.
